name: Files and storage
summary: Store, share and protect your York files

details.title: Student cloud storage
details.html: Undergraduate students receive Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive access; the published UIT guide lists 50 GB in each. Graduate students receive Microsoft OneDrive access, with 50 GB listed in the source. Availability and storage allocations may change with account status

details.title: File Access Service
details.html: File Access Service (FAS) provides managed file shares for York academic, research and administrative work. Access is controlled by Passport York authentication and share permissions. FAS can be used for departmental collaboration and appropriately governed sensitive information

details.title: Storage governance
details.html: Choose a storage service based on the data classification, required sharing permissions and institutional guidance. The published source lists a FAS charge of $0.105 per GB per month, a 50 GB minimum allocation and 10 GB adjustment increments; confirm pricing before submitting a request
